Excellent materials and exquisite craftsmanship, leading quality in the industry

Quality is the core of our products. The main frame of expamdable container house is made of high-strength steel plates. After precise cutting and welding processes, each connection is ensured to be extremely strong and can withstand large external impacts and the test of harsh environments. The wall is made of multi-layer composite thermal insulation and fireproof materials. The outer metal panel has good waterproof and windproof properties. The middle insulation layer effectively blocks heat transfer, creating a safe, comfortable and energy-saving internal environment for you.

Flexible and diverse functional layout, adaptable to various scenarios

In terms of internal space layout, this prefab container house shows great flexibility. When folded, it can be used as an independent storage unit to store various items. When unfolded, you can freely plan the use of the space. If used for residential purposes, it can easily be divided into a comfortable bedroom area, a spacious and bright living room area, a modern kitchen area; and a clean and hygienic bathroom area. If used in the commercial field, such as as a mobile exhibition hall, it can be set up with a display area, a negotiation area and a rest area; as a temporary office, it can be planned into an office area, a meeting room and a data storage area.

Unique expansion design, space changes as you wish

Our expandable container house adopts a highly innovative expansion structure. When not unfolded, it is compact and easy to transport and store, and can easily adapt to various transportation conditions. When arriving at the destination, only a few people can increase the usable area for you instantly through simple operations. From a warm living space to a spacious and open multi-functional commercial area, it can be built as you like, perfectly meeting your diverse requirements for space in different scenarios.

Convenient global delivery and professional after-sales service, a safe choice

We have a complete global delivery service, no matter where you are in the world, we can ensure that the expandable container house is delivered to you accurately. During the delivery process, we will use professional packaging and fixing measures to ensure that the product is not damaged during transportation. At the same time, we also provide a professional after-sales team, who have rich experience in international project services and can provide you with technical support and after-sales service. Whether it is product installation guidance, troubleshooting during use, or later maintenance suggestions, our after-sales team will respond in a timely manner and provide you with efficient and high-quality services

FAQ

1
Can the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing be used in both Australia and New Zealand?
Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is suitable for use in both Australia and New Zealand.
2
What are the dimensions of the expandable housing when fully expanded?
When fully expanded, the dimensions of the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing are approximately 40 feet in length.
3
Is the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing a luxury accommodation option?
Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is designed to provide a luxury accommodation experience.
4
How does the luxury folding container home work?
The luxury folding container home utilizes an expandable design which allows it to be compact during transportation and expand into a larger living space at its destination.
5
Are there any specific applications for the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing?
The Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing can be used for various applications including temporary housing, vacation homes, and additional living spaces.
6
Can the expandable housing be easily transported to different locations?
Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is designed for easy transportation and can be easily relocated to different locations as needed.
